{{Top|leg}}
A '''transfer chip''', also known as a '''data-transfer chip''', was used around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] to transfer [[Currency/Legends|credits]] between different creature's accounts. The transfer chip's features included a miniaturized input module and the ability to instantly transfer credits to bank accounts in a variety of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. Access to a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that had a verify-and-transmit connection with the local [[Bank/Legends|banking exchange]] was necessary.
